substantive_units.result: Proved the complete-P0--P1 five-centre construction is D2C for every r,q>=1 by two mutually safe twin extensions. All 82 base edges have deletion witnesses outside both extension hazard sets, and every new edge has an endpoint witness stable under later extensions.

Derived the exact density gap and found an arithmetic defect in the prior odd-u shorthand. The corrected minimum gap is 11u/2+18 for even u and (11u+37)/2 for odd u, plus floor((r-q)^2/4); the family theorem and edge formula are unaffected.

Classified every maximum-degree root in the five-centre family: Delta=max(11+r,9+q), with root 0 on one side, roots 1,2,4 on the other and a four-root tie at q=r+2. Derived Q=17 or 16 and the root-independent defect delta=5r+7q+26.

Proved every maximum root in the entire two-parameter family has p=0 by finite seed plus twin/monotonicity arguments. Independent regression checked 760 maximum roots and retained X3, so the family does not close the audit's zero-positive-rigid-fixture gap.

Extended the five-centre construction to a clone-closed family with arbitrary positive multiplicities of all six coordinates, P0/P1 and four leaf-star types, keeping only S4 singleton. A single set of 82 base witnesses is safe against every permitted clone hazard, giving an arbitrary-multiplicity D2C theorem.

Solved the exact density optimization inside the clone-closed family: for every n>=22, m_max=4n-7+floor((n-20)^2/4), with positive linear gap from M(n). For n>=24 equality has minimal linear populations and one of the parity or antipodal-star complementary pairs balanced.
Found a stronger n=22,m=83 five-centre base whose star A-graph is K1,4 centred at S7. Exact fixed-multiset MaxSAT proves its 11 A-edges are maximal for the one-copy 13-code population.

Proved the stronger star-hub base is clone-closed under arbitrary positive multiplicities of all six coordinates, P0/P1 and the four leaf-star types, with S7 fixed. All 83 base witnesses are simultaneously safe under every allowed clone operation.
Solved the improved family's internal extremum: m_max(n)=4n-6+floor((n-20)^2/4) for every n>=22, exactly one edge above the prior clone-closed extremum but still a positive linear gap below M(n).

Proved every maximum-degree root in the arbitrary-multiplicity improved five-centre family has p=0. The only finite type with p>0 is the original degree-8 Q3 root, permanently dominated by the P1 hub of degree at least 11; false-twin expansion cannot create tightness.

Completed exact small fixed-population enumeration. Order 21 has one feasible seven-halfcode subset and exactly three labelled A-graphs forming one symmetry class, all with 77 edges. With all halfcodes at order 22 there are seven labelled A-graphs and a unique 83-edge maximum, the S7-hub base.

Extended the exact order-22 near-minimal classification across all 13 one-extra types. Exactly two population mechanisms attain 83 edges: add P0 (the star-hub base) or omit P0 and duplicate S7. This prevents overclaiming uniqueness beyond a fixed code multiset.

Converted the duplicate-S7 order-22 mechanism into a uniform infinite D2C family. With k>=1 S7 vertices, a double-bridge false-twin construction has n=20+k and m=6n-49; a complete safe-witness induction and 50 direct replays pass.

Synthesized the proved five-centre positive-control envelope. The repeated-S7 family is one edge denser at n=23,24,25; it ties the quadratic star-hub family at n=22,26; the quadratic family dominates for every n>=27. Both retain positive linear gap from M(n).

Hostile-replayed the complete five-centre family package. Repaired the odd-u gap formula and uniqueness wording, then reran every proof checker, 4,096 exhaustive binary blowups, 400 larger regressions, rooted/X3 controls and exact small-population enumeration. No further contradiction was found; global five-centre optimality remains explicitly open.

Extended exact graph-level rejection of the two one-copy-negative five-centre support orbits across 96 equal-multiplicity and 200 seeded asymmetric-multiplicity cases, with zero feasible graphs. This is bounded evidence only, not an arbitrary-multiplicity theorem.
